title: Dream Secures $17M to Launch AI Models for the $13T Construction Sector
summary:
A new venture started by Andy Elder and Arjun Mathur is building a class of artificial intelligence models designed to analyze how objects relate to their surrounding environments. These tools focus on physical geometry and constraints to automate reasoning tasks for the architecture, engineering, and construction industry.

Dream raised $17M in seed funding from investors including a16z, SV Angel, XYZ, and Zigg Capital. The company's founders estimate the total addressable market for its spatial reasoning technology at $13T.
